description: MandateKit 0.2 verdict matrix. Both test suites (python/tests/test_v02.py and typescript/test/v02.test.ts) replay every case: build a fresh in-memory store when `store` is true, pin the named trusted keys, supply the listed revocation lists, run the steps in order, and compare the decision and the sorted reason codes in `failed` (and `signature_valid` where given). Envelopes were signed by the Python SDK; the TypeScript suite re-signs each one with the same seed and checks the bytes match. Every step carries an explicit `now` or uses the fixture's; nothing depends on a wall clock. Seeds are test values, never real keys. `parser_cases` replay the rule-based compiler on the same text (expires_at as an ISO string, resolved against `now`) and `iso_cases` list the ISO-8601 strings both verifiers accept (with the normalized instant) or reject.
